// note: IDE-facing config for the Solid test files. The package's tsconfig.json includes only `src` (it's the composite build project), so test .tsx files would otherwise be orphaned and the editor falls back to inferred defaults (jsx: 'react') — erroring on every Solid JSX node. This config (nearest to the test files) gives the editor the Solid JSX settings. The CLI gate `typecheck:tests` still runs ../tsconfig.test.json (src + test); this inherits the same compilerOptions via extends, so they can't drift.
